title: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following') (CWE-59) in Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE) can lead to…
description: Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE) suffers from an improper link resolution vulnerability (CWE-59) that allows unauthorized read and write access to data of other deployments on the same host via a symlink attack. This vulnerability can lead to significant confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts.
